source: Cluster run (Ubuntu 22.04, g++ 12.3, glibc 2.35, Intel Xeon), FlapSim commit deab6c8. Summary only; the per-episode rows of the cluster runs are not included in this repository. Compare only within the cluster.
note: delta: paired ratio difference from paired_report (lower is better), [bootstrap 95% CI]; mcnemar: [arm-only crashes, reference-only crashes, exact p]; hybrid = SNN centre in charge, fire = SNN spike OR plan_v9 pulse law
criterion: hybrid crashes <= probe on kick in >= 4 of 5 seeds

nominal.hybrid_d_probe_note: all five CIs > 0; only seed 1 CI reported

naming: probe = classical + pulse law (the classical controller with its pulse law kept on during manoeuvres, ablate14.ClassicalUnsuppressed); rule = the same arm in P5; snn_s<k> = snn11_s<k>; ppo_s<k> = mlp_ppo_s<k>
note_sustained: the sustained-disturbance conditions of P6 were not reported
